name: Harukawa Gohei
source: Sinister and inscrutable, he is Tomomi's great-uncle, Ippei's brother and a real estate landscaper; although he is rarely seen working in the garden.
translation: Sinister and inscrutable, he is Tomomi's great-uncle, Ippei's brother and a real estate landscaper; although he is rarely seen working in the garden.
